question: Does OSFT's stage-boundary refactor/protection-reference refresh package contribute to acquisition under the fixed limited-data budget, or can continuous learning keep its first-stage factorization?
motivation: The user requires an explanation of effective baseline learning before further compact-framework design. A mechanism probe need not itself delete W0, but must change which adaptation function the future compact framework needs. This is not another compression attempt.
existing_evidence: Original OSFT has an acquisition advantage over Seq in existing completed results, but positions, parameterization, learning rate and projection/refactor are confounded.
ShortFixed weakens the claim that both sides must update; cold-start function-neutral controls did not make first-A-gradient availability sufficient.

Existing projection ablation retained stage refactor in both arms. Merge-reset/intruder discussion was not this executed intervention. Existing geometric/end-state audits cannot supply the missing counterfactual.

Save complete new S1 model state and RNG. Both branches load exactly this tensor state and RNG, start at S2 with empty stage optimizers, and execute S2..19/886FIT/66 updates each. This is planned shared-prefix branching, not an old/failure-checkpoint continuation. No old trained checkpoint/teacher is used.

decision.Refresh_acquisition_higher: Supports a net acquisition contribution of this boundary package at this point. Consider retaining its functional role in later compact adaptation design; not proof of moving subspace, pure coordinate/optimizer causality, universal necessity or all-domain improvement. Final retention/cost may offset the acquired benefit.
decision.Fixed_acquired_and_final_at_least_Refres: Prefer omitting the boundary package as a parsimonious design choice at these point outcomes. No equivalence/noninferiority/significance claim or universal uselessness.
decision.mixed: Record acquisition/retention tradeoff and domains; do not select a universal winner or silently add rank/LR/budget controls. The fixed mechanism comparison ends regardless.
decision.next: No automatic compression, full1313/21454/Ours or model branch. Any subsequent concrete compact framework must separately preserve a usable start, reduce complete final weights and test adaptation. The present experiment reports no final weight advantage.

resources: One genuinely free OLD physical GPU, shared-prefix then Fixed then Refresh serial on that card; protect all formal baselines/others. Restart=no/KillMode=process/no enable. All weights, gradients, moments, SVD/workspace, caches, resources and storage are counted separately. No GPU availability inference from stale PIDs.
